rationale: PINS the awaited-call dedupe (#261 second-pass, found 2026-08-28): `do_connect(host, port).await` previously emitted TWO calls edges — a raw await edge whose target was the FULL function text (`std::net::TcpStream::connect`) plus the canonical leaf edge from handleCallExpression. One call site must produce exactly ONE calls edge, with the isAwait marker on the canonical leaf-target edge. The oracle (deriveRustEdges) derives one `calls do_connect` per site, so the duplicate was a fabrication the differential could only catch on awaited code (ripgrep corpus had none). Counts pin the dedupe (a raw await edge would add a second isAwait edge from the same source).
